privileged_info_for_vlm: The junk tags to be deleted are: 'imported', 'to-read-maybe', 'uncategorized', 'DUPLICATE', '_temp', and 'needs-review'. The tags that must be preserved are: 'deep-learning', 'computer-science', 'information-theory', 'physics', and 'NLP'. The task is performed on a local Zotero SQLite database. Success is defined by the absence of the junk tags and the presence of the good tags in the Zotero tag selector pane.
